_comment: Fragment 47 — D-94: the first Judge deferral answered. Manifest, phase-start rule, duplicate skill removed. Merged 2026-08-22.

nodes.label: D-94 — The First Deferral Answered
nodes.description: The Judge deferred Phase 1 for a missing artifact manifest and a missing verification snapshot, and asked for the Phase 1 and Phase 2 status to be reconciled. All conditions are answered: a 30-path manifest with three declared exclusions, a dated commit-pinned snapshot, a phase-start rule, and check 11 to make the manifest falsifiable.
nodes.rationale: D-93 created the Judge role one pass earlier. Its first exercise found a defect neither the raising lane nor the critic pass found, which is the strongest available evidence that the role was worth creating.

nodes.label: The Critic Checks the Set's Contents; Only the Judge Asks If the Set Exists
nodes.description: The closure specification required an artifact list checkable by ls and no list was ever written, so condition one could not fail. The critic pass read the artifacts the phase produced and asked whether each was sound. It never asked whether the set of them was defined.
nodes.rationale: A structural argument for the Judge being a separate role rather than a stricter critic, produced by the mechanism's first use rather than by reasoning about it. The defect sat inside the document created one pass earlier to prevent exactly that shape.

nodes.label: A Phase Starts at the First Authorized Change to Its Lane's Surface
nodes.description: Readiness feedback is read-only analysis and does not start a phase, so B-001 through B-003 did not start Phase 2. Commit 43c51ce did, by landing build-config.ts, a test, and the Stripe removal. Phase 2 started early and part of non-feature S0 completed.
nodes.rationale: The commit is preserved rather than re-described. Re-labelling a landed commit as something else would be the audit-trail defect this project's own product forbids: an issued record is superseded, never edited. The same rule now governs the Judge's own DEFER verdict.

nodes.label: The Judge Accepts Residual Risk; an Agent Cannot
nodes.description: No agent in this repository acquires human skin in the game, and none can accept legal, financial, or editorial liability. This is why the Judge is a person.
nodes.rationale: D-93 rejected the fourth-agent option on cost and complexity grounds. It would have failed on this ground alone. Recorded because the cheap reading of D-93 is that a critic is a role so a judge could be too, and it could not.

nodes.label: The Procedure That Teaches Propagation Was Never Propagated To
nodes.description: An untracked Codex-adapted duplicate of the sync-docs skill contradicted the lane map. Following it found that the tracked original still carried D-75's pre-D-84 map, with scripts and gitattributes in Lane C, plus obsolete check tallies. The duplicate was removed and the original repaired to cite the lane map rather than restate it.
nodes.rationale: Two copies of one procedure is the drift mechanism, so repairing the copy would have preserved it. A procedure that restates a governed fact will drift from it; one that cites it cannot. G75's lesson applied to a table rather than a number.

nodes.label: A Scope Exclusion Says Nothing About Presence
nodes.description: Check 11's first implementation flagged the CI workflow, correctly excluded from Phase 1 as Lane C's artifact, because it conflated this was removed with this belongs to another phase. Only removal exclusions are falsifiable by presence.
nodes.rationale: A check that reports a disagreement true by design teaches people to ignore it. The same reasoning D-83 used to make lane-boundary report a crossing rather than forbid one, and D-90 used to let an acknowledged-but-open entry pass.

nodes.label: C-22 — No Check Can Prove a Manifest Complete
nodes.description: Check 11 proves every listed path exists. Nothing proves the list is complete, because completeness is a judgment about what a phase was chartered to produce. Stated so a green check 11 is never read as the manifest is right.
nodes.rationale: Not a defect to fix but the boundary of what detection can do, and the same boundary F5 records for the apparatus as a whole. The control is the Judge, which is why the role exists and why its first exercise found precisely this class of gap.
